_howto: Owner: edit on GitHub (pencil icon), then Commit changes — the site updates in ~1-2 min. Add a new {...} at the TOP of items, separated by commas. Fields: title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), blurb (one or two short lines), link (optional, full https:// URL), source (optional, who reported it). Newest dates show first. Only post real news with a source. Keep quotes and commas valid.
